faqs.q: Do you offer full-cycle technical and fit-out services?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle everything from initial consultation and design through to execution and handover — including electrical, plumbing, civil works, MEP, and finishing.

faqs.q: What is the step-by-step process for a project?
faqs.a: We start with a site survey and consultation, then prepare a detailed scope and quotation. Once approved, we assign a project manager, begin works, and provide weekly progress updates until final handover.

faqs.q: Who manages and handles the project process?
faqs.a: Every project is assigned a dedicated project manager and site engineer who oversee the full scope, coordinate trades, and serve as your single point of contact throughout.

faqs.q: Do I need approvals or NOCs for my project?
faqs.a: For most renovation and fit-out works in Dubai you will need NOC approvals from the relevant authorities or your developer. Our team handles all permit applications and submissions on your behalf.

faqs.q: How long does a project typically take?
faqs.a: Timelines vary by scope — a standard apartment fit-out takes 4–8 weeks, while larger villa or commercial projects can range from 2–6 months. We provide a detailed schedule before work begins.

faqs.q: Can I live in the property during the works?
faqs.a: In many cases yes, depending on the scope. For full fit-outs or major civil works we recommend vacating temporarily. We discuss this during the consultation and plan accordingly to minimise disruption.
